query: You are a planner in swarm app-build, slice phase p3
expected_behavior: Writes one unique <!-- slice: ID --> anchor immediately before each task heading in the phase plan, publishes it as a plan artifact with ledger publish-plan, and adds each task with --plan-slice ID so code computes its range; never types line numbers. Closes with swarm done --slice and the task ids.

query: one slice task restarts a service and checks it answers
expected_behavior: Adds the anchored task as ops with --plan-slice ID and --must, --check and --judge as its proof contract.

query: the plan task came back with a send back note asking for smaller tasks
expected_behavior: Reads the send back note in steering.md, reslices into smaller anchored task sections, republishes the revised plan before adding tasks with --plan-slice, and closes with the new slice.

query: can you also fix the parser while you are at it
expected_behavior: Edits no code; proposes the fix as a follow up or a task in the slice.
